headline: M. T. Miskita & Co advises Adani Group on ₹335 crore stake sale in Monte South project developer
sum: Adani Group has sold off its 60% stake in Swayam Realtors and Traders LLP, which is developing the landmark Monte South project at Byculla, Mumbai, to Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited, for an aggregate consideration of up to ₹335 crore,…
detail: Adani Group has sold off its 60% stake in Swayam Realtors and Traders LLP, which is developing the landmark Monte South project at Byculla, Mumbai, to Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited, for an aggregate consideration of up to ₹335 crore, comprising cash consideration of up to ₹135 crore and a bank guarantee of ₹200 crore. M. T. Miskita & Co advised Adani Group on this transaction.

sources.name: Bar & Bench - Dealstreet
